item.text:
1. The line-domination gloss is only conditionally consistent. From \(b<\mu\,\mathrm{childWidth}\), with \(b\in\mathbb N\) and positive \(\mathrm{childWidth}\), one gets exactly \(\mu\,\mathrm{childWidth}\) interior indices; these may be partitioned into \(\mu\) consecutive blocks of that width via Euclidean division. The inequality alone does not encode “child blocks.” Fix the gloss to “the \(\mu\,\mathrm{childWidth}\) interior coordinates,” unless the card also binds the quotient/remainder block decomposition and identifies \(w_i=\mathrm{childWidth}\).

2. The OM role upgrades an open dependency: “the wild self-loop limits [are] the single open hypothesis, so everything downstream is unconditional composition.” Results using an open hypothesis remain conditional, even if subsequent deductions are formal. Replace with: “conditional on the wild self-loop limit hypothesis, the downstream identities follow by composition and geometric-series summation.” The oneliner should likewise say “conditionally resum the wild tower” if it covers those results.

3. The self-contained symbol requirement is not met systematically. Examples include \(p\) not being declared prime in many cards; \(N\) and \(0\le\mu<N\) missing in `landing-cylinder`; domains/positivity for \(p,n,N,m,a\) missing across the MovesC box cards; and domains for \(p,N,n,k,m,D,K,\sigma\) missing in several OM cards. Add a terse opening quantifier line to every card, including positivity and index-range hypotheses.

4. Process/meta-proof language remains prominent: “units,” “ledger,” “interface,” “consumes,” “declared open boundary,” “flagged identifications,” “original plan,” “trusted base,” “footprint,” “mutation refutations,” and documentation-history remarks. Replace these with mathematical status only: definition, hypothesis, counterexample, dependency, or proved conclusion.

5. Collected style nits: the three ROLE paragraphs are substantially longer than terse proof-map prose; several NOTES repeat status/history rather than formulas; “genuine,” “on the nose,” “exactly,” and “literal” are overused; “division-and-carry bookkeeping” is unnecessary jargon.

Verdict: **fix-first** — fix the line-domination gloss, restore explicit conditionality in OM, bind every symbol card-by-card, and remove process-language passages.
